newsitem.title: UK: Russian ex-lawmaker joins Middlesex board.
newsitem.headline: Russian ex-lawmaker joins Middlesex board.

text.p: A former member of the Russian parliament, Alexei Ugarov, has joined the board of metals group Middlesex Holdings Plc, the British company said on Monday.
Ugarov, who was a lawmaker in Moscow between 1990 and 1995, joins Middlesex as representative of Oskol Electrometallurgical Kombinat (OEMK) in which Middlesex has a shareholding of 7.91 percent.
As part of an agreenment signed between the two firms in 1996, Middlesex was given the right to subscribe for a maximum of 20 percent of OEMK's share capital.
Ugarov is currently the general director of OEMK.
